inputs.52.text: 2D anime illustration with soft cel shading, clean thin dark-brown line art, gentle painterly gradients. Full-body character reference of an elderly man in his seventies standing straight and facing the viewer, hands loosely clasped in front of his apron. Short neat white hair, a lined kind face, round thin gold wire glasses, a faint closed-mouth smile. He wears a gray wool cardigan buttoned over a white collared shirt, a long brown canvas apron tied at the waist reaching below his knees, dark brown trousers and black leather shoes. Slightly stooped, slender build. Plain off-white background, even soft studio light, the figure centred and filling the height of the frame.
